scope: Model 1, entity 1, label chains A/B/C in the released asymmetric units.

candidates.required_inputs: One checksum-matched, released mmCIF per invocation and one mask parameter.
candidates.applicability: Quantifies shared-atom coverage and fits chain pairs for common_ca, common_backbone or ordered_backbone.
candidates.limitations: A second entry or mask requires a separate invocation. The values describe deposited coordinates.

candidates.applicability: Counts per-chain and shared positive-occupancy backbone atom identities and the observed-union denominator.
candidates.limitations: Its release is scoped to 2RE9. The inventory does not supply a fitted rotation or RMSD.

candidates.required_inputs: Single-deposition Goal, original 2RE9 material and the workflow's inventoried atom selections.
candidates.applicability: Its stage dependencies connect inventory to a proposed measurement, assessment, decision and report.
candidates.limitations: The historical static recipe describes the original 2RE9 study. Its graph is a reference when composing other studies.

evaluation_gap: Check atom-selection coverage and the denominator on each authorized entry before interpreting a joint geometric comparison.
